```{r}
#   James

library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)

CT_clean <- read.csv("CT_clean.csv")
CT_clean <- CT_clean %>% 
  filter(!is.na(county_name), !is.na(driver_age), !is.na(driver_age_group))
#Gets rid of missing data

search_rate_by <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    group_by({{ var }}) %>%
    summarise(
      n_stops     = n(),
      n_contraband  = sum(contraband_found),
      contraband_proportion = mean(contraband_found),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(contraband_proportion))
}
#function to find proportion of contraband for any variable

 
#county_name vs contraband

county_search <- search_rate_by(CT_clean, county_name)
county_search #Based off first look there appears to be difference in proportion.

chisq.test(CT_clean$county_name, CT_clean$contraband_found)
#Chisq test find sifficent evidence of difference in proportion

CT_clean$county_name <- factor(CT_clean$county_name)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ county_name, family=binomial, data = CT_clean)
summary(lr) #Model shows significant affect from Litchfield, Middlesex, and Tolland County.

#driver_gender vs contraband

gender_search <- search_rate_by(CT_clean, driver_gender)
gender_search #First look there apperas to be a lrage difference in proportions

CT_clean$driver_gender <- factor(CT_clean$driver_gender)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ driver_gender, family=binomial, data = CT_clean)
summary(lr) #significant affect from both Male and Female

#driver_age vs contraband

age_search <- search_rate_by(CT_clean, driver_age_group)
age_search #First look, there appears to be a difference based on age

chisq.test(CT_clean$driver_age_group, CT_clean$contraband_found)
#Chi squared test concludes that there is sufficient evidence that at least one proption is different

CT_clean$driver_age_group <- factor(CT_clean$driver_age_group)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ driver_age_group, family=binomial, data = CT_clean)
summary(lr) #Test shows a significant affect in all groups.

#driver_race vs contraband

race_search <- search_rate_by(CT_clean, driver_race)
race_search #Fist look there appears to be difference based on gender

chisq.test(CT_clean$driver_race, CT_clean$contraband_found)
#Chi squared test concludes that there is sufficient evidence that at least one proption is different

CT_clean$driver_race <- factor(CT_clean$driver_race)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ driver_race, family=binomial, data = CT_clean)
summary(lr) #There is a significant affect for Black, White, Hispanic and Asian.

#violation vs contraband

violation_search <- search_rate_by(CT_clean, violation_group)
violation_search #First look, there appears to be a difference based on violation

chisq.test(CT_clean$violation_group, CT_clean$contraband_found)
#Chi squared test concludes that there is sufficient evidence that at least one proption is different

violation_group <- factor(CT_clean$violation_group)
lr <- glm(contraband_found ~ violation_group, family=binomial, data = CT_clean)
summary(lr) #Shows significant affect for all groups other than speeding

```
